title: Bigger Isn't Always Memorizing: Early Stopping Overparameterized Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.16959v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion probabilistic models have become a cornerstone of modern generative AI, yet the mechanisms underlying their generalization remain poorly understood. In fact, if these models were perfectly minimizing their training loss, they would just generate data belonging to their training set, i.e., memorize, as empirically found in the overparameterized regime. We revisit this view by showing that, in highly overparameterized diffusion models, generalization in natural data domains is progressively achieved during training before the onset of memorization. Our results, ranging from image to language diffusion models, systematically support the empirical law that memorization time is proportional to the dataset size, consistent with a kernel-regression bound on the time required to fit the empirical score at low noise. translated_title: 更大并不总是意味着记忆：过参数化扩散模型的早停
translated_abstract: 扩散概率模型已成为现代生成式人工智能的基石，然而其背后的泛化机制仍知之甚少。事实上，如果这些模型完美地最小化其训练损失，它们将只会生成属于训练集的数据，即产生记忆化现象，这正如在过参数化机制中被实证观察到的那样。我们通过展示高度过参数化的扩散模型中，自然数据领域的泛化能力在训练过程中、在记忆化发生之前被逐步实现，来重新审视这一观点。我们的结果涵盖从图像到语言的扩散模型，系统性地支持如下经验规律：记忆化时间与数据集大小成正比，这与低噪声情形下拟合经验得分函数所需时间的核回归界相一致。因此，泛化与记忆化最好被理解为不同时间尺度之间的竞争。我们展示了这一现象……
tldr: 过参数化扩散模型在训练中先于记忆化发生之前逐步实现泛化，记忆化时间与数据集大小成正比，因此泛化与记忆化本质上是时间尺度的竞争，可通过早停来避免记忆化。
en_tdlr: Overparameterized diffusion models progressively achieve generalization during training before the onset of memorization, with memorization time proportional to dataset size, framing generalization versus memorization as a competition between time scales that can be managed by early stopping.
